test_ufunc: test numpy ufuncs like np.multiply and np.power on polars Series with various numeric dtypes
test_ufunc_null_propagation: test that null values are preserved and propagate correctly through numpy ufuncs on polars Series
test_ufunc_chunked_series: test numpy ufuncs work correctly on chunked polars Series with multiple chunks
test_numpy_string_array: test numpy string operations like np.char.capitalize on polars String Series
test_generalized_ufunc: test numba generalized ufuncs (guvectorize) can be called directly on polars Series
test_generalized_ufunc_missing_data: test that generalized ufuncs raise ComputeError when polars Series contains null values
test_generalized_ufunc_different_output_: test generalized ufuncs with different input and output array sizes on polars Series
